overview: The Transport Hub is Ka Vethan’s central routing nexus, regulating void‑arcane transit and civic movement across the city.
history: Constructed to unify Ka Vethan’s multi‑tiered districts.
Void‑aligned platforms added to stabilize long‑distance transit.
Luclinite conduits expanded to support resonance‑regulated lifts.
Praesertum decrees formalized transit licensing and routing doctrine.
Modern Hub remains the busiest infrastructural center in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A transit conduit destabilizes during peak routing.
A void‑aligned platform emits anomalous resonance.
Transit stewards request help with corrupted routing echoes.
A Praesertum directive alters transit licensing rules.
